title: Intricacies of frustrated magnetism in the Kondo metal YbAgGe
task: Elucidate interplay of frustration, Kondo screening, and itinerant electrons in distorted Kagome metal YbAgGe
key_results: Dynamic magnetic correlations below T*≈20 K; antiferromagnetic long-range order at TN=0.68 K with significantly reduced modulated moment
comments: Study reveals that local-moment descriptions are insufficient for frustrated Kondo metals; itinerant-electron coupling must be explicitly included in models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frustrated interactions in Kondo metals produce simple antiferromagnetic ordering
hypotheses.result: Partially refuted: ordering occurs but with anomalously reduced moment, indicating itinerant-electron effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: RKKY or Kondo-only frameworks explain frustration behavior
hypotheses.result: Refuted: more sophisticated models incorporating both itinerant and localized-electron coupling needed
